build_annotated_dataset: build a subclass of AnnotatedObjectsDataset to load annotated object images with bounding boxes and category labels
setup_transform_pipeline: create a transform pipeline using setup_transform with center crop, random flip, and normalization for image preprocessing
filter_annotations_by_area: filter object annotations by minimum area and object count range using filter_object_number static method
build_conditional_builders: build conditional builders for objects center points and bounding boxes using the conditional_builders property
apply_image_transform: apply image transforms including crop, flip, and normalization to a tensor using image_transform method
